title: Loot Icons for D&D 5e
description: A template icon library for D&D 5e items in a painterly digital-art style. Ships a set of archetype icons (flask, vial, scroll, chest, ingot, ...) and assigns them automatically to items by name, with runtime rarity highlighting. Icons are transparent 200x200 WebP files, usable in the Foundry file picker under the module tab.
